The '''Pokémon Sumo Tournament''' (Japanese: '''ポケモン相撲大会''' ''Pokémon Sumo Tournament'') is an {{pkmn|animated series}}-exclusive competition that is held on [[Harvest Island]] during the [[Grand Harvest Festival]]. It was featured in ''[[BW134|The Journalist from Another Region!]]''.

==History==
The Pokémon Sumo Tournament was established when a {{p|Beartic}} and {{p|Ursaring}} of Harvest Island folklore fought. Since then, other Pokémon participated as well. The winner of the tournament receives a [[Focus Band]] and a lifetime supply of some fruit.
